name: Tonal
tagline: One seed color, tonal surfaces, no glass: a calm, opaque redesign of the whole window.
description: A whole cmux look in which every color comes from one seed through tonal palettes: the page, the chrome a few tone steps off it, selection and Send in the primary. Opaque surfaces instead of glass, tone instead of shadows and hairlines, the work in one rounded card, a filled primary Send. Three seeds ship: Tonal (sage-teal, airy, the default), Tonal Ink (indigo-violet, vivid containers) and Tonal Clay (terracotta, warm and dense), each in Light and Dark. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
